newsitem.title: USA: Paradigm Medical says delays shipments.
newsitem.headline: Paradigm Medical says delays shipments.

text.p: Paradigm Medical Industries Inc said Thursday it has delayed shipments of its cataract removal system originally scheduled for June until late July.
The company said it is delaying the shipments because scheduled shipments of the product, called Precisionist ThirtyThousand, were not delivered by ZEVEX International Inc its manufacturer.
Shipments are expected to resume by July 30th. Production of the first 19 units was completed as expected on March 31.
Paradigm said Zevex said the delayed shipments in June were a result of the company moving into expanded facilities while at the time undergoing product refinements.
Paradigm said the delay is offset by the long-term benefits of Zevex moving into its newly constructed, 50,000 square foot facility which increases production capacity.
